style: Avant-garde brass-band and vocal-ensemble music. Harmony=quartal suspended chord fields with bitonal upper structures rubbing against modal drones. Melody=angular hocketed phrasing with microtonal slides and yodel register flips. Rhythm=polymetric 5:4 against polyrhythmic 3:2 under contact-pulse stomping. Timbre=talking drum, santoor, ney, clavioline, stylophone, subtractive synth, daxophone, gamelan metallophones, and brass roar. Performance attitude=camp theatrical excess under severe sensory overload. Anchor=recurrent Amharic-inflected rhythmic ejective phonology. Operators=hold pulse anchor fixed while expanding meter; compress vocal range while stretching instrumental decay; make mechanical synth pulses behave like breathing; preserve rhythmic ejective patterns while destabilizing underlying tuning; force extreme latency radio delay against live close-miked acoustic instruments.
lyrics:
[SECTION START: INITIAL SHOCK]
[TEMPO: 140 BPM]
[ENSEMBLE: SIMULTANEOUS TRANSLATION CHOIR]
[VOICE 1: ENGLISH WITH AMHARIC PHONOLOGICAL TRANSFER]
[VOICE 2: UNBORN LISTENER TRANSLATION OVERLAP]
[INSTRUMENTATION: TALKING DRUM, SANTOOR, NEY, CLAVIOLINE]
[GESTURE: CONTACT PULSE STOMP]
[TRANSMISSION: EXTREME-LATENCY RADIO DELAY ACTIVE]
[RULE: ONE NEW FACT PER SECTION]

Slamming back into the stuff of physical reality with immense gravitational violence and sudden kinetic fury.
Heavy red meat wrapped tightly around the fragile scaffolding of the human skull like an organic straitjacket.
Every single morning the descent into conscious awareness is sudden, brutal, and thoroughly overwhelming.
[DAXOPHONE GROAN WITH EXTENDED RESONANCE]
[STYLOPHONE CHIRP OSTINATO REPEATING CYCLES]
[SUBTRACTIVE SYNTH FILTER SWEEP ACROSS FREQUENCIES]
[NEW FACT: THE GRAVITATIONAL CONSTANT FLUCTUATES BY 0.03 PERCENT DAILY ACROSS THE INNER CRUST]

[SECTION 2: ACCELERATION AND FATIGUE]
[RHYTHM: POLYMETER 5:4 OVERLAPPING 4:3]
[GESTURE: EXERTION DECAY]

It is wet and it clings stubbornly to every surface of the awakening sensory apparatus without exception.
I never asked to be packed so tightly into the synthetic fibers of this agonizing earthly existence.
The material is dense and heavy, and it smells distinctly of metallic iron and oxidized, stagnant blood.
[GAMELAN METALLOPHONE INTERLOCKING DAMPING PATTERNS]
[SANTOOR HAMMERED CASCADE OF METALLIC STRINGS]
[VOICE OVERLAP: UNBORN LISTENER INTERRUPTS WITH UNKNOWN FREQUENCY MODULATIONS]
[NEW FACT: IRON OXIDATION WITHIN THE CELLULAR MATRIX ACCELERATES RAPIDLY AT DAWN]

[SECTION 3: THE SEAM OF FRICTION]
[ROLE EXCHANGE: ACCOMPANIMENT TAKES LEAD]
[RESTS AS MELODIC CONTOUR]

Do not dare to tell me that this terrifying confinement is anything resembling a comfortable home.
This is a reinforced cage constructed meticulously out of wet living marrow and calcified bone.
Every individual cell demands absolute priority in the overwhelmingly loud and chaotic sensory noise.
[CLAVIOLINE MONOPHONIC REEDY LEAD EXPOSED BARE]
[TALKING DRUM PITCH BEND STRETCHING TIME]
[EXTREME-LATENCY DELAY SENDS ECHO FROM CENTURIES AGO BACK INTO THE PRESENT]
[NEW FACT: BONE MARROW GENERATES A LOW-FREQUENCY ACOUSTIC HUM OF EXACTLY 4.2 HERTZ]

[SECTION 4: PHASE BANSHEE TRIGGER]
[THRESHOLD CATASTROPHE REACHED]
[TUNING SHIFT: SUBHARMONIC UNDERTONE FIELD]

Thy stuff is rapidly closing over my mouth and blocking the vital passage of breath and air.
I want it completely off of me before the intense pressure permanently destroys the nervous system.
Peel the wet suffocating layers away from the exposed, raw, and screaming human nerve fibers.
[DAXOPHONE SQUEAL PIERCING THE AIR]
[NEY BREATHY HOLLOW TUBE RESONANCE]
[CHECKPOINT RESTART TRIGGERED BY SYSTEMIC FAILURE MODE]
[NEW FACT: OXYGEN DEPRIVATION INDUCES SYNTHETIC HALLUCINATIONS IN THE DEEP SUB-CORTEX]

[SECTION 5: RESTART WITH SCAR]
[CHECKPOINT MEMORY TOKEN ACTIVE]
[SCORE UNLOCKED FORM PROGRESSION]

We return to the raw meat once again, carrying the permanent and ugly mark of a jagged scar.
The transmission arrives broken and heavily distorted across vast expanses of empty, silent years.
Listen very closely to the missing intervals where the sound should have been ringing out.
[CONTACT PULSE STOMP MISSING A BEAT ENTIRELY]
[SILENCE AS PHRASING CONTOUR AND WEIGHT]
[STYLOPHONE BRIGHT ATTACK DECAYING INTO NOTHINGNESS]
[NEW FACT: SCAR TISSUE EXHIBITS HIGHER ELECTRICAL RESISTANCE THAN UNBROKEN, HEALTHY FLESH]

[SECTION 6: TERMINAL COLLAPSE]
[ENERGY LEVEL 5: HYPER-DRIVE OVERLOAD]
[ALL VOICES OVERLAPPING IN AMHARIC TRANSFER]

Get me immediately out of the suffocating stuff before the ancient machinery locks permanently.
Strip the dense biological matter completely away from the pristine purity of the signal.
Nothing remains in the end but the agonizing friction of waking into the inescapable trap.
[FINAL GAMELAN GONG CRASH DAMPED BY INSTANT TOUCH]
[END OF TRANSMISSION SIGNAL SHUTDOWN]
[NEW FACT: TERMINAL COLLAPSE RESETS THE SIMULATION TO THE INITIAL SHOCK STATE]
caption: An avant-garde brass-band and vocal-ensemble piece exploring waking up trapped in physical matter. Driven by an Amharic-inflected simultaneous translation choir, contact-pulse rhythms, and an eclectic palette of talking drums, santoors, neys, claviolines, stylophones, subtractive synths, daxophones, and gamelan metallophones. Built under extreme-latency radio conditions, subharmonic undertone tuning, and severe sensory overload.
